guide.title: 2026-2027 Indiana Fishing Regulations Guide
guide.note: The DNR guide is published on eRegulations (linked from the DNR page). It is a summary; the full rules are in Indiana Administrative Code Title 312.

statewide.title: Indiana’s Statewide Size & Bag Limits

rows.species: Black Bass: largemouth, smallmouth, and spotted bass (in lakes)
rows.bag: 5, any combination of largemouth, smallmouth, or spotted bass

rows.species: Black Bass: largemouth, smallmouth, and spotted bass (in rivers and streams)
rows.bag: 5, any combination of largemouth, smallmouth, or spotted bass
rows.size: No fish 12 to 15 inches may be kept, and no more than two fish over 15 inches may be kept (exceptions: Bass Regulations)

rows.species: Black Bass: largemouth, smallmouth, and spotted bass (in Lake Michigan)
rows.bag: 3, any combination of largemouth, smallmouth, or spotted bass
12, any combination of white bass or hybrid striped bass
rows.size: No more than two fish may exceed 17 inches

rows.bag: 6, any combination of walleye, walleye-sauger hybrid, and sauger
rows.size: For walleye: 14 inches south of SR 26; 16 inches north of SR 26 For sauger and saugeye: No size limit (exceptions: Basic Fishing Information)
24 inches; no more than one 30 inches or longer

rows.species: Catfish: Channel, Blue, Flathead (in rivers and streams)
rows.size: 13 inches; not more than one blue catfish that’s at least 35 inches, one flathead catfish at least 35 inches, and one channel catfish at least 28 inches or longer may be kept
None; not more than one blue catfish that’s at least 35 inches, one flathead catfish at least 35 inches, and one channel catfish at least 28 inches or longer may be kept

footnotes.text: 9-inch minimum size at Dogwood Lake (Daviess County) and Hardy Lake (Scott County).
44-inch minimum size at Backwater, Kiser, and Webster lakes (Kosciusko County).
No more than 6 per day from Hamilton Lake (Steuben County).
No minimum size limit for Northern pike at Hamilton Lake (Steuben County), with no more than 1 per day more than 30 inches long.
No bag limit for channel catfish at Turtle Creek Reservoir.
Daily bag limit at J.C. Murphey Lake (Newton County) is 25 singly or in aggregate.

statewide.possession: The possession limit is two times the daily bag limit and does not apply to a wild fish that is processed and stored at an individual’s primary residence.

extras.quote: On State-owned, leased, or managed lakes smaller than 300 acres, only electric trolling motors may be used. No more than two 12-volt batteries or one 24-volt battery can be used to power trolling motors on these waters.
You may not fish with more than three poles or hand lines at a time.

On Fidler Pond in Elkhart County, Failing Lake (also known as Gentian Lake) in Steuben County, and Flat Fork Creek Park ponds A and B in Hamilton County, a person cannot take more than:
items: 2 largemouth bass per day, and the largemouth bass must be at least 18 inches long
15 of any combination of bluegill, redear sunfish, and crappie per day

lake-george-steuben.quote: Walleye taken north of State Road 26 must be 16 inches in length or longer, except for: … Lake George (Steuben County); minimum size 15 inches

Indiana and Michigan — Residents of Indiana or Michigan may fish the whole lake, but must abide by the regulations in the waters they are fishing. Nonresident license holders (for either state) may only fish in the waters under which the jurisdiction applies for that nonresident license. … Lake George — Indiana, Steuben Co./Michigan, Branch Co.

Boat ramps are located on following lakes: Shock, Spear, Hammond, Allen, Barrel ½, Price, Wyland, Bass, and Goldeneye. … Lakes are limited to electric motors only.

special_scope: Lake-specific entries are matched by name and county to the lakes named in the 2026-27 guide (Size & Bag Limits footnotes, Walleye and Special Regulation Waters sections; Bass Regulations lake limits; Inland Trout brown trout waters; Basic Fishing Information border waters) and the DNR Tri-County FWA property page.
